paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rav Yosef’s student and Abaye’s colleague, citing Shabbat 60a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Shabbat 60a has Rav Ada of Naresh expounding before Rav Yosef. That passage supports the association with Rav Yosef; it does not independently establish the additional relationship to Abaye stated by Hyman.

The saved Davidson Shabbat60a scalar has Rav Ada of Naresh expounding before Rav Yosef. It supports that association, not an independently established student relationship or the additional colleague relation to Abaye. Hyman’s two relationship statements retain their force as his descriptions. Full Rav belongs to Ada and Yosef; no rank is added to Abaye.
